Hi Connor,

Quick update from our side — engineering hit a hard stop on Friday while wiring up the SSO adapter and the in-house infra team has flagged a security gating item that will take ~3 weeks to resolve. Our demo window with the product team is now at risk and we won't be able to complete the connector work within the original 30-day POC.

Given the delay, can Redwood provide a 30-day trial extension and a small sandbox credit pool so our devs can continue testing once the blocker is cleared? We'd be asking for something like $2k in sandbox credits to cover additional runs while we finish the adapter.

We really like the latency figures and the team is committed — this is just a timing/ops hiccup. Procurement is on this thread for formalities.

Thanks —

Why I recommend approval:
- Novatech is in an active pilot with clear intent to move to a paid tier if demo succeeds (see HubSpot notes).
- The blocker is infra/security on their side, not a product defect.
- Granting a modest makegood buys momentum and preserves the sales window.

Proposed commercial motion: 30-day free extension + $2,000 sandbox credit applied to their pilot account. I can ship a formal approval email and update HubSpot/DocuSign with an addendum.

Attachments: novatech-integration-tracker.xlsx (internal tracker)
